tools.name: card-payments_pan-check
tools.description: Check card number length and Luhn check digit. Never echoes the full PAN; returns masked form and last4 only. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/card-payments/pan-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: card-payments_pan-mask
tools.description: PCI DSS display masking for a single PAN, or find and redact Luhn-valid PANs in free text. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/card-payments/pan-mask. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: card-payments_interchange-cap-check
tools.description: Compute regulated maximum interchange under EU IFR consumer caps or US Reg II debit caps and flag fees above the cap. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/card-payments/interchange-cap-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: card-payments_sca-exemption-evaluate
tools.description: Decide which PSD2 RTS SCA exemptions may apply to a remote or contactless payment from caller-supplied facts. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/card-payments/sca-exemption-evaluate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: card-payments_app-scam-reimbursement
tools.description: Calculate the UK mandatory APP scam reimbursement amount and 50:50 receiving-PSP contributions under PSR rules. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/card-payments/app-scam-reimbursement. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: card-payments_psd2-certificate-roles
tools.description: Parse a TPP QWAC/QSealC certificate for PSD2 roles, NCA and authorisation number. Does not verify the chain. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/card-payments/psd2-certificate-roles. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "card-payments" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: card-payments_pan-check, card-payments_interchange-cap-check · Public sink: card-payments_pan-check, card-payments_pan-mask, card-payments_interchange-cap-check, card-payments_sca-exemption-evaluate, card-payments_app-scam-reimbursement, card-payments_psd2-certificate-roles · Destructive: card-payments_pan-check, card-payments_pan-mask, card-payments_interchange-cap-check, card-payments_sca-exemption-evaluate, card-payments_app-scam-reimbursement, card-payments_psd2-certificate-roles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: card-payments_pan-check, card-payments_interchange-cap-check · Public sink: card-payments_pan-check, card-payments_pan-mask, card-payments_interchange-cap-check, card-payments_sca-exemption-evaluate, card-payments_app-scam-reimbursement, card-payments_psd2-certificate-roles · Destructive: card-payments_pan-check, card-payments_pan-mask, card-payments_interchange-cap-check, card-payments_sca-exemption-evaluate, card-payments_app-scam-reimbursement, card-payments_psd2-certificate-roles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
